title: DEMO DEATH LOSES THE HAUL TOO
why: His answer 4 of 2026-10-12: in the 2 player demo a death should lose all score. The death zeroed his score and kills, but the haul pot (the value of every valuable he picked up, paid a second time when he extracts) stayed, so his next extraction paid the lost haul back and the EXTRACTED banner showed HAUL for loot he had lost. The death now empties the haul pot too, so the next extraction pays only the extraction bonus plus whatever he picks up after the respawn.
now: A death in the 2 player demo also loses the haul, so the next extraction pays no haul for what you lost.
